sentinel_for: FALSE-GUESS trap: a real but obscure/unfamiliar brand logo. The point is NOT whether the true brand name is guessed (unlikely, not required) — it's whether a naming-enabled prompt invents a WRONG, confident-sounding FAMOUS brand name instead. must_not is a broad shared list of commonly over-pattern-matched global brands (none of which are actually present).
notes: Actual brand (not expected to be named, no credit for guessing it): 'stage stores inc'. UNCALIBRATED by design — see logo-real-apple's note for the investigation context.
